plain: To make something clear by explaining it.

webster.text: To make clear or manifest; to explain; to remove obscurity from, and render intelligible; to illustrate.

example.quote: With the people they have to manage, I would hint to them, their zeal is not their best weapon, and exertions of such a kind, artful attempts to seize the moment, do seldom tend either to elucidate and explain principles, or ensure success.
example.cite: John DeWitt III, Boston American Herald, Nov. 5, 1787
